evidence_items.explanation: The study finds persistent compositional generalization limitations across model scales and training methods. It also reports gains from in-context learning and prompt tuning, so it does not establish an absence of progress on the core problems.

The paper reports improved image-generation results, including comparative human evaluation. It supports progress in another dimension, but the authors' description of language understanding is not proof that Marcus's core problems were solved.

evidence_items.explanation: GPT-2 and GPT-3 showed unreliable discourse-entity tracking, alongside improvements in larger models. Tracking whether a noun phrase introduces an entity is related to reference but does not directly establish confusion between individual knowledge and category knowledge.

The study documents improvements from human-feedback training, including human preference for instruction-following outputs. It supports progress in language interaction while acknowledging remaining mistakes.

unresolved_gaps: No direct contemporary test located establishes Marcus's specific claim about separating knowledge of individuals from knowledge of kinds.
The evidence establishes important unresolved capabilities, but does not settle every component of the named set.
A looser reading that only some core problems remained would support a different overall outcome.
